page.layout: One text column, running head above it, page number at the top left. No marginal notes. The right edge shows the neighbouring page, which is not transcribed.

main_text.l: num, integrum, nulla sui parte lacera-
tum, contortum aut maculatum accepi, ante autem libri tui felicem vectionem,
ad te scribere nolebam, ne de literis tuis
sine libro acceptis nuntio adveniente li-
bri in periculum adducti scrupulum in-
statui. Itaque cum tuum nactus sim,
olim ad me misisti, judicium facio, nunc
gentia tua me consecutum scripsi; qua-
nebam mihi primùm tria aut quatuor fo-
liola, non plura in Samaritani Penta-
teuchi illustrationem typis committere, sed discendi

page.notes: The first word "num," is a fragment carried over from the previous page. The catchword "ram" is printed at the lower right, below the last line. Both "&" are printed as "&". The v printed for the vowel u in "qvæ", "qvas", "qvatuor" and "Itaqve" has been read as u, following the spelling rule. No doubtful readings.
